Agent Chat Orchestration
|-- [M] Modular structure: interactive chat + independent canvas alternatives
|   |-- Client boundary: AgentChatPanel -> HTTP actions + SSE subscription
|   |   |-- Exposes conversations, model/access settings, Send, Read Canvas, Stop and answers
|   |   `-- Keeps tab selection, drafts, retry identities and stream buffering in the client
|   |-- Application boundary: routes -> AgentChatService
|   |   |-- Exposes session lifecycle, turns, tool dispatch, generation and event subscription
|   |   |-- Keeps session/thread indexes, pending requests and concurrency guards internal
|   |   `-- Routes omit toolDefinitions, generationRequests and generation.history
|   |       `-- Large completed tool items become previews; item endpoint supplies full detail
|   |-- AgentChatService -> injected capabilities
|   |   |-- ChatStore: load/save conversations
|   |   |-- CodexConnection: request/respond/reject/subscribe
|   |   |   `-- StdioCodexConnection hides process startup, JSON framing and RPC correlation
|   |   |-- ChatCanvasReader + ChatMcpBinding: read canvas and bind tools to a conversation
|   |   |-- ChatTools: definitions + call(name, input, turn context)
|   |   |   `-- ChatDiagramTools -> AgentDiagrammingSessionService
|   |   |       |-- Exposes diagram edits, views, highlights, projections and saved contexts
|   |   |       `-- Keeps target resolution, revision checks and retry preparation internal
|   |   `-- GenerationCanvasBridge + context-library read + generation observer
|   |       `-- Supply isolated canvases, saved context and evaluation reconciliation
|   `-- CanvasSessionPort boundary: GenerationCanvasBridge
|       |-- Live canvas ID -> delegate to the live port
|       `-- Generation canvas ID -> private MappingDocumentController
|           `-- Same read/edit port; unsupported operations and binding mismatches fail
|-- [C] Interactive conversation: caller -> invocation -> result
|   |-- Panel creates or resumes a conversation -> service
|   |   |-- create -> thread/start with chat instructions and available tools -> save session
|   |   `-- resume(native thread ID) -> reuse/import once -> thread/resume
|   |       |-- Preserve native instructions, history, cwd and model; reject active threads
|   |       `-- Imported session starts without chat canvas tools
|   |-- Send / Read Canvas -> startTurn
|   |   |-- Known request ID -> return; running/starting/reloading turn -> reject
|   |   |-- Read Canvas -> shortContextForCanvas -> read_canvas tool output
|   |   |-- Resume native thread when needed -> capture canvas/references -> bind tools
|   |   `-- Save client request ID before turn/start
|   |       |-- Send supplies text + captured references; Read Canvas supplies tool output
|   |       `-- Lost HTTP response can retry the same request without starting another turn
|   |-- App-server messages -> receive -> thread ID resolves owning chat
|   |   |-- Text/reasoning/tool deltas -> merge and flush in batches, normally after 32 ms
|   |   |-- Items, plans, usage and state -> reduceChatEvent -> listeners
|   |   |   `-- SSE snapshot/parts + live events -> ChatStream -> panel transcript
|   |   |-- Question or approval -> pending request -> panel answer -> connection.respond
|   |   `-- turn/completed -> settle open items and pending requests -> save terminal state
|   |-- Tool invocation -> dispatchTool
|   |   |-- Native item/tool/call -> validate tool and active turn identity
|   |   |-- Bound HTTP tool call -> resolve binding token; require running chat with tools
|   |   |-- gen-alternatives -> managed child generation below
|   |   `-- Other tools -> ChatDiagramTools.call -> agent API
|   |       |-- Mutation access checks; reference/node resolution; current revision checks
|   |       |-- Prepare once per retry identity; changed arguments -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|   |       `-- Direct edit -> submitDirect; status/cancel require this chat to own the run
|   `-- Reload tools while idle -> unsubscribe/resume existing thread with refreshed MCP
|       `-- Reload server inventory -> verify tools -> inject updated instructions -> save
|-- [C] Generate alternatives: one request -> independently scheduled child turns
|   |-- Validate parent, writable access, tools, user message and source canvas
|   |   |-- Nested generation is rejected; generated chats are retained for review
|   |   `-- Request ID + argument signature -> reuse receipt or reject conflicting retry
|   |-- Prepare shared run -> optionally read saved AgentContext -> allocate candidate IDs
|   |   `-- Persist child records + parent receipt -> start candidate views at source version
|   |       `-- Capture source history and inputHistory -> publish run to generation observer
|   |-- For each candidate, schedule launchGeneration; sibling order is not execution order
|   |   |-- Saved context supplied -> thread/start -> inject captured context as reference data
|   |   |-- Otherwise -> thread/fork at parent turn boundary
|   |   |   `-- Fork before an active parent turn, or through the retained last turn
|   |   `-- Clear inherited goal -> add isolated canvas -> mark generating -> start one turn
|   |       `-- Child uses its own thread, MCP binding and controller through the same tools
|   |-- Completion / failure / cancellation -> finishGeneration
|   |   |-- Classify finished, failed or cancelled -> capture history -> persist child
|   |   |-- Publish evaluation update -> synchronize candidate view on source canvas
|   |   |   |-- Finished -> include generated history
|   |   |   `-- Failed/cancelled -> publish terminal metadata without applying result history
|   |   `-- Save unavailable -> retain child result and report pending save
|   |       `-- Later generations query retries terminal synchronization after reconnect
|   `-- Evaluation rerun -> same child executor with retained source history and settings
|       `-- Reconnect source by stable workspace identity when its live ID has changed
|-- [O] Responsibility and lifetime
|   |-- AgentChatService retains sessions, request receipts and child generation histories
|   |   |-- ChatStore supplies persistence; closing a UI tab keeps the conversation
|   |   |-- Stop on parent -> cancel running children -> interrupt parent turn
|   |   `-- Restart -> running chats/items become interrupted; active generations become failed
|   |-- GenerationCanvasBridge creates and retains one controller per active candidate
|   |   |-- Initialize from captured history with a fresh context ID
|   |   |-- Serialize commands per controller; retain mutation receipts for identical retries
|   |   |-- Mutation -> export history -> callback saves it into the child session
|   |   `-- Generation settlement finally -> clear binding, remove controller, unsubscribe thread
|   |       `-- Persisted child/history survives removal of the active controller
|   |-- StdioCodexConnection owns app-server process + outstanding RPC timers
|   |   |-- First request -> spawn -> initialize; replies settle matching promises
|   |   |-- RPC timeout -> reject after 30 seconds
|   |   `-- Process loss -> reject pending RPCs; service clears bindings and fails active work
|   |       `-- Service disposal unsubscribes and disposes connection; connection kills process
|   `-- Each SSE response owns heartbeat + service subscription
|       `-- Response close clears both; panel selection change closes its EventSource/buffer
`-- [D] Data dependency: what results require, across the organization above
    |-- Prepared diagram edit
    |   |-- Tool arguments + captured turn canvas/references -> target and base revision
    |   |-- Current document snapshot + selected anchors -> validated edit ranges
    |   `-- Prepared operations + snapshot version + attached session -> submitDirect input
    |-- Candidate result history
    |   |-- Captured source history [shared H] -> initial state of every isolated controller
    |   |-- Candidate model input
    |   |   |-- Shared task + candidate prompt + inherited model/effort settings
    |   |   `-- Saved context snapshot OR forked history + trigger prompt/captured references
    |   `-- Validated mutations applied to [shared H] -> that candidate's exported history
    |       `-- Each candidate evolves independently; siblings do not consume each other's edits
    |-- Candidate token usage
    |   `-- Reported total - baseline derived from first last-request usage
    |       `-- Excludes inherited fork history from the candidate's measured usage
    `-- Published generation result
        |-- Child terminal status + timestamps + usage + retained history
        |-- Source canvas identity + candidate view ID -> canvas synchronization
        `-- Children sharing runId + parent session -> evaluation observer
            `-- Observer errors retain child chat/view; evaluation internals are outside these sources
